basic_details.job_title: CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for 19 Project Assistant, Project Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-National Geophysical Research Institute (CSIR NGRI) Project Personnel Notification 2026 has been released on 27 July 2026 on the official website www.ngri.res.in. A total of 19 vacancies have been announced through the CSIR NGRI Project Personnel Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NGRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application form is 03 August 2026. However, the walk-in interview dates are scheduled for 05, 07, and 11 August 2026, depending on the post code.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Personnel at CSIR NGRI?
faq.answer: CSIR NGRI has announced a total of 19 vacancies for the Project Personnel posts. These vacancies are distributed across various specific roles within the Project Personnel category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CSIR NGRI Project Personnel Recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Personnel posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Project Personnel posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and OBC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Which qualifications are required for the Project Assistant-II (PA-II) post?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant-II (PA-II) post, candidates need to have a Diploma in Engineering/Technology (EEE/ECE/EIE) of 3 years full-time duration or a B.Sc. degree in Physics, Geology, Chemistry, or Computers.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the Project Personnel positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Personnel positions ranges from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 78,000/- per month, plus HRA, depending on the specific post and qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSIR NGRI Project Personnel Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Personnel posts at CSIR NGRI involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the CSIR NGRI located?
faq.answer: CSIR-National Geophysical Research Institute (CSIR NGRI) is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500007.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and up to 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.
